title: Default Parameters
prompt:
Write two functions in `solution.py`:

**Requirements:**
1. `power(base, exponent=2)` -- returns `base` raised to `exponent`. The exponent defaults to `2` (squaring)
2. `build_profile(name, **kwargs)` -- returns a dictionary with a `"name"` key set to `name`, plus all additional keyword arguments merged in

**Examples:**
```python
power(3)           # 9
power(2, 10)       # 1024
build_profile("Alice", age=30, role="dev")
# {"name": "Alice", "age": 30, "role": "dev"}
```
hints: **kwargs collects extra keyword arguments into a dict
Use dictionary unpacking {**kwargs} to merge dicts

solution.py.name: power
solution.py.description: Define a power function with base and exponent parameters

solution.py.name: build_profile
solution.py.description: Define a build_profile function that accepts a name and keyword arguments
Use **kwargs to accept arbitrary keyword arguments
